tasks.description: Implement GameLoop.ts — the main game orchestration module. This is the most critical file in the codebase. runDungeonPhase(state, config): main dungeon round loop. Each round (every round_interval_ms=2000): 1) Read game-config.json (picks up patches). 2) Compute FOV for each active agent using rot.js (update tiles[y][x].visibleTo). 3) Fire all 4 POST /decide/:agentId calls in parallel staggered by 150ms each (0, 150, 300, 450ms). 4) Collect responses with 3s timeout. Timed-out agents get fallback { goal: 'pass' }. 5) resolveConflicts(actions) using CONFLICT_PRIORITY from types.ts — lower-priority conflicting action converts to pass. 6) applyAgentAction(state, agentId, action, config): execute the agent's action — move updates position (clamped to map, blocked by walls), attack triggers resolveCombat, pick_up_item adds to backpack, use_estus heals, equip_from_backpack swaps items. 7) resolveEnemyActions(state) via EnemyAI. 8) Apply enemy moves (update enemy.position from newPosition). 9) Apply enemy attacks via resolveEnemyAttack. 10) StateEmitter.broadcast() and logEvent() for ROUND_STATE. 11) Check dungeon timer expiry + grace periods. teleportToArena(state): compute dungeon scores, seed arena bracket, transition phase to ARENA_SEMI1. runArenaMatch(state, config, matchup): alternating turn combat between two agents, turn cap from config.arena_turn_cap (default 30, FAST_MODE 20). resolveConflicts(actions): per CONFLICT_PRIORITY, conflicting actions (same target) convert lower-priority to pass. transitionPhase(state, to): already implemented — reuse it. CRITICAL: call resetEnemyAIState() from EnemyAI at the start of runDungeonPhase (PITFALL 2). CRITICAL: arena_turn_cap must never be 0 — default to 30 (PITFALL 3). Use setInterval for round timing with proper cleanup. All functions use immutable state patterns — create new state objects, never mutate.
tasks.acceptance: npm run build exits 0. runDungeonPhase processes rounds with 2s intervals. Agent actions are resolved per conflict priority. Enemy actions follow agent actions each round. ROUND_STATE events are logged each round. Dungeon timer expiry triggers teleportToArena. teleportToArena seeds arena bracket correctly (seed 1 vs 4, 2 vs 3). runArenaMatch resolves alternating turns with stamina/damage system. Turn cap enforced (no infinite arena matches). resetEnemyAIState called at dungeon phase start. No module-level state leaks. All round-lock invariants respected.

tasks.description: Implement run-full-game.js — the headless game orchestration script. This is the entry point for acceptance testing and evaluator runs. Steps: 1) Load dotenv (import 'dotenv/config' or dotenv.config()). 2) Import generateDungeon and computeAgentSpawns/computeEnemySpawns/computeChestContents from DungeonGen. 3) Import runDungeonPhase, teleportToArena, runArenaMatch from GameLoop. 4) Import startServer, setGameState from server.ts. 5) Read game-config.json. 6) Call resetEnemyAIState() from EnemyAI. 7) Generate dungeon with a random seed. 8) Create initial GameState with 4 agents at spawn positions, enemies at spawn positions, ground items from chest contents. 9) Set initial agent states: starting_hp=150, starting_stamina=100, starting equipment per SPEC (aggressive=sword, cautious=dagger+leather_armor, hoarder=dagger, speedrunner=dagger), estusCount=3. 10) If --headless flag: skip server start, just run phases directly and print results. 11) If no --headless (live mode): start server (same process — PITFALL 1), set game state to play mode, run dungeon and arena phases. 12) After game ends: print GAME_COMPLETE to stdout with final scores per agent. Exit 0 on success. Support NO_API=true env var (skip real API calls, use getFallbackAction for all agent decisions). Support FAST_MODE=true (dungeon_timer=120 instead of 300, arena_turn_cap=20 instead of 30). Support --seed=N flag for deterministic runs.
tasks.acceptance: NO_API=true FAST_MODE=true node run-full-game.js --headless exits 0 and prints GAME_COMPLETE to stdout. All 4 agents make at least 1 decision. Dungeon timer fires and teleport occurs. 2 semis + 1 final resolve. Winner declared with final scores. ROUND_STATE events logged to game-events.jsonl. NO_API=true uses fallback actions only (no real API calls). FAST_MODE=true completes within 90 seconds. --seed=42 produces deterministic output. With real API key: real Claude decisions are made (not all fallback).

completed.description: Implement AgentAPI.ts and PatchApplier.ts — the two remaining independent modules needed before GameLoop can be wired. AgentAPI.ts: loadPersonalityPrompt(agentId) reads personalities/{agentId}/CLAUDE.md using fs.readFileSync, returns the raw markdown string. callClaude(agentId, payload, timeoutMs) constructs a POST to https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages with model=claude-haiku-4-5 (DUNGEON) or claude-sonnet-4-6 (ARENA_FINAL per MODEL_BY_PHASE), system prompt from the personality file, user message as JSON-serialized AgentStatePayload, max_tokens=300, temperature=0.7. Read ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from process.env (throw if missing). Use AbortController for the timeout. Parse the response JSON, extract the agent action from the content string — expect JSON like { goal: 'move_to_enemy', targetId: 'enemy_0', reasoning: '...' }. Fall back to getFallbackAction(agentId) on any error (network, timeout, parse failure) and log [fallback] in reasoning. handleDecideRoute is the main entry point that wraps callClaude. PatchApplier.ts: readConfig() reads game-config.json with fs.readFileSync and JSON.parse. readBaseline() reads game-config.baseline.json similarly. getNestedValue/setNestedValue use dot-path to access nested config keys (e.g. 'stamina.heavy_attack_cost'). applyPatch(suggestion) validates the new value is within ±30% of baseline, writes the updated config atomically (write to tmp file, fs.renameSync to game-config.json), and returns the old value. Log rejections to stderr with the reason. Both files compile with npm run build. No TODOs or stubs.
completed.acceptance: npm run build exits 0. Rejected patches log to stderr. getNestedValue('stamina.heavy_attack_cost', config) returns 30 (default).
